scope: Display membership corrections for two existing source families. Preserve all accepted country outlines, game polygons, authoritative administrative parents, and unrelated presentation memberships.

references.observation: The administrative history places Chayu under Nyingchi since 1986 and records its continuation under Nyingchi City in 2015.
The county profile places it in southeastern Tibet, bordering Deqin and Gongshan in Yunnan and Myanmar to the south. This corroborates the requested gap location.

families.geometryLimitation: Raw county and ADM1 polygons have different country-outline coverage. Use corroborated parent identity for the existing whole gameplay family; do not import the raw county outline or change any country boundary.

references.observation: The district profile identifies Junshan as part of Yueyang in Hunan, established in 1996.
The district publishes its 2020 statistical bulletin, corroborating the district identity at the scenario period.

families.geometryLimitation: The raw family is almost entirely within the Hunan source polygon. Its existing game adjustments narrowly exceed the previous overlap-only classification cap; official parent evidence resolves display identity without changing those polygons.
